overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the notice topic "Superintendent Search Process" was specific enough to cover the salary-range discussion and vote, though more detail would have helped.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Jan. 21 notice topic 'Superintendent Search Process' was too vague because it did not say the committee would discuss and vote on the superintendent salary range.
allegations.key_passage: we find that discussion was within the scope of the posted topic, "Superintendent Search Process," such that any member of the public interested in the superintendent search process had sufficient information to decide whether to attend the meeting.
